fullContent:
Kantakari Ghrita – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali first part 
 Introduction 
 Kantakari Ghrita is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to be prepared from the mixture of herbs. In this formulation ghee is used as a base. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ghrita 
 Kantakari Kwatha 
 
 Ingredients for Kalki (Paste) Preparation:- 
 
 Rasna 
 Balamool 
 Shunthi 
 Pippali 
 Maricha 
 Goshura 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 First of all take cow’s ghee (clarified butter). Now make the kalka from given ingredients. 
 Now collect the whole parts in a container and cook on mild flame. 
 Dry the mixtur. 
 
 Dosage 
 6 to 12 grams, two times a day with cow milk. 
 Indications 
 
 In all kinds of respiratory infections. 
 Asthma 
 Bronchitis 
 Productive cough 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the formulation under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
